title: Canonicalize Sales/CS feature asks for rapid feasibility and cost sketch
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Sales and CS are receiving varied, free-form enterprise feature asks that are slow to evaluate and often lack implementation context. That causes long handoffs, uneven prioritization, and repeated clarifying conversations. Goal: Create a 'canonicalizer + speed-scope' micro-process that turns a Sales/CS request into a one-page decision artifact in under 48 hours. The artifact should include a normalized problem statement, top-3 solution approaches (with a single recommended MVP), a feasibility band (S/M/L = estimated engineering weeks), an infra/ops impact note, and a priority score. Deliverables: 1) Intake canonicalization template (Airtable + Confluence spec). 2) Lightweight scoring model and cheat-sheet for Solutions Engineers. 3) 48-hour SLA for a first-pass speed-scope. 4) Small UX for triage status (Slack + ticket comment). Where this lives: canonicalized outputs stored in Airtable (table: Enterprise Speed Scopes) and linked to Linear ticket; long-form docs go to Confluence page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Enterprise+Speed+Scope. Implementation owner: PM (Aisha) with Solutions Eng (Diego) and 1x ENG on-call reviewer for infra estimates.
acceptance_criteria: Airtable template created and available with required fields and examples
Confluence spec with step-by-step flow and decision rules published
First-pass speed-scope produced for 10 pilot asks within 48 hours
Triage cheat-sheet adopted by Sales and CS (ack from Solutions Eng leads)
Linear ticket auto-updated with a link to the speed-scope artifact
scoring_model: Priority score = (Account ARR weight 0.4) + (Customer impact 0.3) + (Strategic alignment 0.2) - (Estimated engineering effort factor 0.1). Feasibility band: S <= 2wks, M 2-6wks, L 6+wks. Use weights to bucket into High/Medium/Low priority bands.
template_fields: Suggested next step (e.g., scoped spike, research, product spec)

outcome: A repeatable, low-friction path from Sales/CS ask to a decision-ready speed-scope. Expected benefits: reduce clarifying cycles by ~40%, faster prioritization for enterprise work, clearer handoffs to ENG and Solutions. Primary artifact: Airtable row + one-paragraph Confluence summary + tagged Linear ticket.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Sales keeps submitting incomplete information — Mitigation: mandatory minimal fields in intake form and Solutions Eng will only accept requests that meet the template
Risk: Engineering estimates biased high/low — Mitigation: calibration sessions with ENG reviewers and a living rubric
Risk: Overload of speed-scope work — Mitigation: queue cap and SLA exceptions for top-tier accounts only
